scientific_integrity: All parameter inequalities follow from exact invariant blocks, polynomial discriminant, and shifted cubic Routh-Hurwitz stability. Standalone symbolic/numerical verification is corroborative and not an infinite proof. Priority is qualified by incomplete access to a supplementary document and absence of independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Single-particle, open three-site path with equal hopping J>0 and uniform continuous Markovian site dephasing gamma>0. Only the center-localized pure state versus reflection-odd diagonal perturbations is addressed; no bound at gamma=0, no extension to longer chains, and no uniform crossing-time claim.
title: Symmetry-protected photonic Mpemba acceleration for every dephasing strength on a three-site chain
